basis: Skin/subcutaneous atrophy and skeletal abnormalities characterize many progeroid syndromes; cardiovascular and neurologic damage vary substantially by subtype.
Collagen VI myopathy with skeletal muscle weakness, necrosis, fibrosis and joint contractures.
Bilateral loss of labyrinthine vestibular function is an inner ear disorder.
Metaplasia confined to the uterine cervix, a reproductive organ outside the axes.
Ovarian germ cell neoplasm; reproductive origin without defining endocrine dysfunction.
Hereditary colorectal cancer syndrome; other listed cancers are risks of separately diagnosed diseases, not direct organ involvement.
Respiratory ciliary dysfunction with bronchiectasis; chronic otitis media in 4/4 supports persistent middle ear involvement.
Ovarian dysgenesis causes primary gonadal endocrine failure, elevated gonadotropins and delayed puberty in 3/3.
Motor neuron disease with denervation amyotrophy in 7/8; left ventricular hypertrophy in 2/6 (~33%) supports cardiac involvement, with limited sample certainty.
Corneal Bowman layer and epithelial dystrophy causing corneal opacity and variable visual impairment.
Nonsyndromic intellectual developmental disorder; intellectual disability in 6/6, without evidence of a metabolic phenotype.
Immune-mediated CNS demyelination and neurodegeneration with progressive neurologic loss of function.
Defined by intellectual disability, developmental delay and brain abnormalities; cardiac findings lack evidence of involvement in at least 30%.
Renal-retinal ciliopathy encompassing Senior-Loken syndrome 7 and Bardet-Biedl syndrome 16; nephronophthisis and retinal degeneration are shared core features.
Tumor of ovarian sex cord/steroidogenic stromal cells, characterized by sex steroid production and hormone excess.
Kidney-restricted mineralocorticoid resistance causes renal salt wasting, hyperkalemia, hyponatremia and metabolic acidosis.
Thyroid primary carcinoma; airway invasion/stenosis and lung tumor involvement are frequent (30-79%). Dysphagia alone does not establish gastrointestinal damage.
Neonatal Candida infection; the broad concept specifies no organ site consistently affected in at least 30%.
Macular/choroidal disease with choroidal neovascularization and visual loss; vascular changes are localized ocular pathology.
Diffuse overgrowth of subcutaneous adipose tissue; steroid exposure or hormone excess is the cause, not evidence of endocrine gland damage.
Pigmentary/vascular malformations define disease; cerebral atrophy 80-99%, glaucoma 30-79%. Reduced bone density 80-99% omitted under cap; umbrella frequencies uncertain.
Structural narrowing of the coronary sinus, a cardiac venous vessel.
Defined by abnormal pupil function; neurologic causes are not universal to this umbrella concept.
Congenital thumb aplasia, hypoplasia or deformity; unspecified cardiovascular abnormalities lack frequency and causal evidence.
Brain calcification with ataxia, dysarthria and cognitive impairment; isolated ANA positivity and CSF pleocytosis do not establish autoimmune disease.
